description: Detect convergence: startups followed by 2+ of your tracked accounts (min_accounts, default 2) independently in the window. Startups only: a result must be marked a company in our curated companies table (entity type company, project, protocol or product) with at most 25,000 X followers. People, investors, VC firms, media, organizations, public companies and big established brands are left out, as is anything not yet classified. When 3+ tracked investors independently follow the same startup, it strongly suggests pre-funding interest. frontrun_companies stays the full catalog. Default window 7d.

min_accounts.description: Minimum tracked accounts that must follow. Default: 2. Use 3+ for high-conviction.

scope.description: Whose follows to read: "tracked" (default, your tracked accounts), "network" (the whole Frontrun network, paid Pro plans) or "list:<id>" (one of your lists from frontrun_lists, with its sectors).

name: frontrun_convergence
